project_outcome.statement: No improved zero-density coefficient, prime-interval endpoint, or L-function-family transfer is proved. The checked baseline remains density coefficient 30/13, with uniform and almost-all interval endpoints 17/30 and 2/15.

why_active_gate_matters.statement: Within the explored coefficient-sensitive lower signed-alias route, smooth-halo anti-alignment can survive only through simultaneous lcm resonance, gcd-weighted capacity, and a negative tail-transform lobe. Bounding that population or classifying its divisor-fan extremizers is the present route to a genuine signed estimate.

progress_criterion.statement: Cycle 152 advances E14D-L only with either a strict weighted bound on a nonempty, explicitly frozen denominator region or a proved explicit divisor-fan inverse; a heuristic cancellation, a scalar collision bound, or isolated endpoint norm aggregation does not advance the gate.

cold_start_handoff.deferred_work: Boundary denominators within a fixed power of Q are a separate branch; paper-stage hostile audit begins only after a manuscript theorem is frozen.
